Hi Liam —

Thanks for registering for the Redwood deep-dive at last week's fintech webinar. Glad you were able to join the session — lots of great Q&A on latency and cost tradeoffs.

I'd love to schedule a short 20-minute walkthrough tailored to Finport to show:
- how Redwood reduces per-token cost with batching & KV cache,
- a quick look at our Hosted vs Dedicated options for production inference, and
- how you could map one of your queued gen workloads to a predictable cost + latency profile.

Are you available for 20 minutes next week? Here are a few options (all PT):
- Tue Jul 20, 9:30–9:50am
- Tue Jul 20, 11:00–11:20am
- Wed Jul 21, 8:30–8:50am

If none of those work, reply with 2 slots that do. I attached a short PDF with a high-level overview.

Thanks — happy to include any specific folks from your team (security, infra, or SRE) if helpful.

Best,
Monica Patel
